_comment: Plays before every run after the first, on a dark confessional, once the player has picked where to start on the start screen. The voice has no name plate; in the true ending it turns out to be Father Eli. 'last_line' is the voice beginning where the player chose. 'more' is what the voice says after any ending but the true one. 'epilogue' is the true ending, played when a run ends with nobody dead and Father Eli's own confession. See docs/STORY_BIBLE.md, sections 6 and 10.

lines.text: Basbasan n'yo po ako, Padre, dahil nagkasala ako.
Matagal na po mula nung huli akong nangumpisal.

tokhang.text: Magsisimula po ako sa palengke. Linggo ng hapon.

kumpisal.text: Magsisimula po ako sa simbahan. Sabado, bago magdilim.

padala.text: Magsisimula po ako sa kwarto. Sa likod ng pintong nakakandado.

more.text: Hindi pa po iyon ang buong kumpisal, Padre.

lines.speaker: Father Eli
